messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — need to finalize launch criteria for "Optimize Playbook: Friction Reduction" RFC. customers asking for per-route batching suggestions + quant defaults. Can we align on must-haves by EOD?
Sam (Eng-ML): do we mean public Toolkit or internal ops guidance?
Maya (PM): both — public docs + config schema for console. must support hosted & dedicated.
Carter (Eng-Platform): essentials: 1) reproducible perf tests, 2) fallback policy when quantized model accuracy drop > X, 3) migration guide + version pinning.
Olivia (Design): need examples + a single page flow for console defaults and toggles.
Priya (SRE): SLOs to add: latency P95 targets per-route and a clear reject path for bursts. include observability hooks (trace, token-cost).
Sam (Eng-ML): proposed acceptance criteria snippet:
```
- Eval harness runs for all supported model variants and reports delta vs baseline
- Automated canary with auto-rollback if accuracy delta > 1.5% absolute
- Console shows per-route recommended batching/quant profiles
```
Carter (Eng-Platform): define "accuracy delta" — 1.5% absolute ok? some customers will want 1%.
Maya (PM): suggest 1.5% for initial canary threshold, allow customer override to 1% via console flag.
Sam (Eng-ML): I can add unit prompt sets + synthetic load to prove perf and quality. will wire regression alerts.
Olivia (Design): UX copy: default toggle "Cost savings (may affect quality)" with tooltip linking to example diffs.
Priya (SRE): runtime guardrails: if KV cache hit rate < 20% or P95 exceeds SLO, disable batching and notify.
Sam (Eng-ML): acceptance criteria to include automated gating steps and a sample API config for recommended profiles.
deploy-bot: rfc/opt-playbook scheduled -> staging deploy 2024-06-05T18:00:00Z :rocket:
Maya (PM): MVP checklist: docs + console toggles + canary pipeline + perf harness. rollout = 2-week canary then gradual ramp.
Carter (Eng-Platform): timeline ok. I'll create infra capacity ticket and plan GPU pool reservations.
Priya (SRE): i'll own canary runbook and incident steps.
Sam (Eng-ML): will draft PRD + include eval config and sample prompts, aiming for PR by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (PM): great — I'll consolidate into PRD draft and post link here. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
